test_profile: Release cfg/debug-assertion conditions; test-only opt-level=0 for codex-tui, codex-core and codex-app-server, with 16 codegen units. Runtime measurements use the separately built optimized CLI.
comparison_scope: Installed release versus patched main; not a same-base full-CLI A/B. Synthetic source-matched Windows Terminal paste adapter through native OS ConPTY and a headless xterm renderer; physical Ctrl+V not observed.
metrics: Marker-render readiness excludes separate Ctrl+G export; exact compares complete exported prompt to the synthetic input plus marker. Input and wire SHA-256 match between baseline and candidate.

functional.case: Fragmented boundaries, delayed close, leading and trailing empty lines
CRLF and LF normalize without losing lines
Repeated spaces, empty lines and indentation
Paste at middle cursor preserves both sides
Narrow resize preserves the complete large draft
Typing and Backspace after largest and repeated pastes
Empty terminal paste preserves existing draft
Ctrl+C clears draft without closing CLI
Leading slash-command multiline paste does not execute on paste
Multiline command-like paste remains literal before Enter
Explicit Enter sends complete synthetic prompt to local receiver

not_verified: Physical IME and national keyboard layouts
Image clipboard and physical mouse selection
